post.description: Creates a new user account and sends an email confirmation link.

get.description: Validates the confirmation token and marks the user's email as confirmed.

post.description: Resends the email confirmation link. No-op if the email is already confirmed or does not exist.

204.description: Confirmation email sent (or silently skipped if already confirmed)

post.description: Authenticates a confirmed user and returns an access + refresh token pair.
Issues a new access + refresh token pair using a valid refresh token.

401.description: Invalid, expired, or reused refresh token

post.description: Sends a password reset email. No-op if the email is not registered.

204.description: Reset email sent (or silently skipped if email not found)

post.description: Resets the user password using a valid reset token.
Revokes all active refresh tokens for the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile from the JWT payload.

post.description: Registers the video as a draft in the user's channel and starts a resumable multipart upload, signed part by part afterwards. The video is addressed only by its publicId.

201.description: Draft video and active upload session

413.description: sizeBytes above the maximum video size, informed in the message (VIDEO_TOO_LARGE)

415.description: contentType other than video/mp4 or video/webm (UNSUPPORTED_VIDEO_TYPE)

503.description: The storage could not start the upload; no usable session was created (STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE)

post.summary: Create a video draft and its first upload session

get.description: Returns the state of the video, the metadata extracted by the processing and its current upload session, for the owner. It is the route of the polling while the video is processed.

parameters.name: publicId
parameters.description: Public id of the video, 11 base64url characters

200.description: State, metadata and current upload session of the video

404.description: Video not found or of another channel (VIDEO_NOT_FOUND)

get.summary: Get the state and the metadata of a video

get.description: Issues a presigned GET of the original on the public storage endpoint, valid for PLAYBACK_URL_TTL_SECONDS, for the owner of a ready video. The video is played by progressive download: the storage answers Range requests with 206 Partial Content and Content-Range, and the bytes never pass through the API. Request a new URL when it expires.

parameters.name: publicId
parameters.description: Public id of the video, 11 base64url characters

200.description: Presigned playback URL, its content type and its expiry

404.description: Video not found or of another channel (VIDEO_NOT_FOUND)

get.summary: Get a short-lived URL to play a ready video

get.description: Issues a presigned GET of the original on the public storage endpoint, valid for DOWNLOAD_URL_TTL_SECONDS, for the owner of a ready video. The storage answers it as an attachment named after the original file name (filename* in UTF-8, with an ASCII fallback in filename; RFC 6266), and the bytes never pass through the API.

parameters.name: publicId
parameters.description: Public id of the video, 11 base64url characters

200.description: Presigned download URL and its expiry

404.description: Video not found or of another channel (VIDEO_NOT_FOUND)

get.summary: Get a short-lived URL to download the original of a ready video

post.description: Creates a new upload session, with a new key for the original, for a draft video, and aborts the previous session. The video declares the new file. The new session starts without the file mismatch block of the previous one.

parameters.name: publicId
parameters.description: Public id of the video, 11 base64url characters

201.description: New active session, ready to sign parts

404.description: Video not found or of another channel (VIDEO_NOT_FOUND)

409.description: The video is not a draft (VIDEO_INVALID_STATE), its current session is completing (UPLOAD_SESSION_COMPLETING) or being created (UPLOAD_SESSION_INITIATING), or the activation lost the new session to another restart (UPLOAD_SESSION_NOT_ACTIVE)

413.description: The file is larger than the limit (VIDEO_TOO_LARGE)

503.description: Transient failure of the storage (STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE); the new session ends aborted and the video stays a restartable draft

post.summary: Restart the upload of a draft video

get.description: Returns the state of the session and, for an active session, one entry per part of the plan, classified against the parts listed by the storage. It is the base of the resumption.

parameters.name: publicId
parameters.description: Public id of the video, 11 base64url characters

200.description: State of the session and its classified parts

404.description: Video not found or of another channel (VIDEO_NOT_FOUND), or session not found (UPLOAD_SESSION_NOT_FOUND)

410.description: The storage no longer knows the upload of the active session, which is aborted (UPLOAD_SESSION_EXPIRED)

503.description: The storage could not list the parts (STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE); the session is not changed

get.summary: Get the upload session and the state of its parts

delete.description: Claims the session for abort and aborts its multipart upload in the storage until the storage confirms that it is gone. The video stays in draft and can restart the upload. Repeating the call on an aborted session has no new effect.

parameters.name: publicId
parameters.description: Public id of the video, 11 base64url characters

204.description: The session is aborted, or stays aborting while a part in transit prevents the confirmation; the sweep concludes it

404.description: Video not found or of another channel (VIDEO_NOT_FOUND), or session not found (UPLOAD_SESSION_NOT_FOUND)

409.description: The session is completing (UPLOAD_SESSION_COMPLETING), is being created (UPLOAD_SESSION_INITIATING), or is completed (UPLOAD_SESSION_NOT_ACTIVE)

post.description: Signs, in one batch, the PUT of each part with its exact size and its SHA-256, and registers the ETags of the parts already sent. The bytes go from the browser straight to the storage.

parameters.name: publicId
parameters.description: Public id of the video, 11 base64url characters

200.description: Signed parts and the parts whose ETag was registered

400.description: Validation failed, or a part number above partCount or repeated in the batch (INVALID_PART_NUMBER)

404.description: Video not found or of another channel (VIDEO_NOT_FOUND), or session not found (UPLOAD_SESSION_NOT_FOUND)

409.description: Session not current or not active (UPLOAD_SESSION_NOT_ACTIVE), checksum different from the registered one or session blocked (UPLOAD_FILE_MISMATCH), or ETag of a part never signed (UPLOAD_PART_NOT_SIGNED)

post.summary: Sign upload parts and register ETags

post.description: Compares the SHA-256 recalculated for every part already received (confirmed and unregistered) with the registered checksums. A different checksum blocks the session until an explicit restart.

parameters.name: publicId
parameters.description: Public id of the video, 11 base64url characters

400.description: Validation failed, a part outside the plan or without a registered checksum (INVALID_PART_NUMBER), or a part already received left out (UPLOAD_VERIFICATION_INCOMPLETE)

404.description: Video not found or of another channel (VIDEO_NOT_FOUND), or session not found (UPLOAD_SESSION_NOT_FOUND)

409.description: Session not current or not active (UPLOAD_SESSION_NOT_ACTIVE), or a checksum different from the registered one, which blocks the session, or a session already blocked (UPLOAD_FILE_MISMATCH)

410.description: The session has expired, or the storage no longer knows its upload (UPLOAD_SESSION_EXPIRED)

503.description: The storage could not list the parts (STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE); nothing is recorded

post.summary: Verify the file selected again on the resumption

post.description: Checks every part against the storage, completes the multipart upload from the registered parts and moves the video to processing, publishing its processing job. Repeating the call after the success returns the current state of the video.

parameters.name: publicId
parameters.description: Public id of the video, 11 base64url characters

200.description: The session was already completed as the current one of the video; current state of the video

202.description: This call completed the upload and moved the video to processing

404.description: Video not found or of another channel (VIDEO_NOT_FOUND), or session not found (UPLOAD_SESSION_NOT_FOUND)

409.description: Another completion is in progress (UPLOAD_SESSION_COMPLETING), the completion was reverted by another call (UPLOAD_COMPLETION_INTERRUPTED), a part is missing or has no registered ETag (UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE), the storage differs from the registry (UPLOAD_PART_MISMATCH), the session is blocked (UPLOAD_FILE_MISMATCH), or it is not the current active session (UPLOAD_SESSION_NOT_ACTIVE)

410.description: The session has expired, or the storage no longer has its upload nor the completed object (UPLOAD_SESSION_EXPIRED)

503.description: Transient failure of the storage (STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE); the claim expires and the next call resumes

fileName.description: Name of the file chosen by the user, from 1 to 255 characters.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the whole file in bytes: a safe integer of at least 1.

contentType.description: MIME type of the file in the `type/subtype` format, e.g. `video/mp4`.

partSize.description: Size in bytes of every part except the last

durationSeconds.description: Duration in seconds, filled by the processing

errorCode.description: Filled when the video is in error

uploadSession.description: Current upload session of the video

url.description: Presigned GET of the original on the public storage endpoint; it answers 206 Partial Content with Content-Range to Range requests

contentType.description: Content type of the video, signed as the response type

expiresAt.description: Expiry of the URL: emission + PLAYBACK_URL_TTL_SECONDS

url.description: Presigned GET of the original on the public storage endpoint, answered with Content-Disposition: attachment and the original file name in filename* (UTF-8, RFC 6266)

expiresAt.description: Expiry of the URL: emission + DOWNLOAD_URL_TTL_SECONDS

UploadPartState.description: confirmed: present with the registered ETag, checksum and size; missing: absent from the storage; divergent: present but different from the registry; unregistered: present without a registered ETag

state.description: confirmed: present with the registered ETag, checksum and size; missing: absent from the storage; divergent: present but different from the registry; unregistered: present without a registered ETag

checksumSha256.description: Registered SHA-256 of the part, base64 with padding; null when the part was never signed

expired.description: true when the session is active and its expiresAt has passed

fileMismatch.description: The file check failed, or a part was signed again with another checksum; the session no longer signs parts

partSize.description: Size in bytes of every part except the last

parts.description: One entry per part of the plan, from 1 to partCount, only for an active session; empty in the other states

partNumber.description: Number of the part, from 1. The upper bound `partCount` is checked by the service (400 INVALID_PART_NUMBER).

checksumSha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes of the part, in base64 with padding (44 characters).

partNumber.description: Number of a part whose checksum is already registered.

etag.description: ETag read from the response of the PUT of the part.

completedParts.description: Parts already sent, with the ETag of their PUT, up to 150.

x-amz-checksum-sha256.description: Declared SHA-256 of the part, base64 with padding

url.description: Presigned UploadPart URL on the public storage endpoint

expectedSize.description: Exact number of bytes of the body, sent as a Blob or an ArrayBuffer; any other size is refused by the storage

registeredParts.description: Parts whose ETag was registered by this request

partNumber.description: Number of the part, from 1. The plan (`partCount`) and the registered checksum are checked by the service (400 INVALID_PART_NUMBER).

checksumSha256.description: SHA-256 recalculated from the exact bytes of the part of the file selected again, in base64 with padding (44 characters).

parts.description: Parts already received by the storage, up to 150, each once. An empty list is valid when no part was received.

verifiedParts.description: Number of parts whose recalculated checksum matched the registered one; 0 when no part was received

status.description: Current state of the video; always processing in the 202 answer
